# OptimisedWebsite

## About
OptimisedWebsite builds SEO-optimised Astro 5 websites for UK businesses. 15-50 pages with topical authority architecture, entity-linked JSON-LD schema, and perfect Core Web Vitals. Fixed price £1,500-£3,000. 5-7 day delivery.

## Services
- SEO Website Build: Complete Astro 5 site with hub-and-spoke architecture
- Keyword Research: Niche analysis, keyword clustering, topical mapping
- Schema Markup: Entity-interconnected JSON-LD (7-12 types per site)
- Technical SEO: Sitemap, robots.txt, canonicals, Core Web Vitals
- Content Architecture: Internal linking strategy, heading hierarchy
